notes.title: Steam Deck/Linux Demo Transfer Patch
notes.content:
Demo transfers now work when using Proton, which Steam uses on Linux and Steam Deck.

If you haven't launched the game yet, it will just work.

If you have already launched the game and have data in the full game and want to transfer it from the demo instead, do these steps:

[olist]
[*] Launch Full Game
[*] Delete save slot you want to transfer to
[*] Exit Game
[*] Launch Demo
[*] Open save slot you want to transfer from
[*] Toggle an item on or off in the cat shop
[*] Exit the shop.  You'll see a save icon in the bottom-right.
[*] Exit Demo
[*] Launch Full Game
[*] Select the save slot.  It will show New Game, but when selected, it should do the save transfer.
[/olist]

If you have any issues, please let us know!

notes.content:
New challenges, and some fixes! Can you clear the new level variants?

[list]
[*]Added some level variants to [spoiler]Nightmare Mode.[/spoiler]
[*]Added support for more controllers. PS5 DualSense, Nintendo Pro Controllers and more will work without extra setup.
[*]Added some new sound effects and graphics to make things more clear in [spoiler]the jungle.[/spoiler]
[*]The first fish item now unlocks at 3 fish instead of 5.
[*]Fixed replays not displaying properly on some hardware.
[*]Fixed Swirly glasses disappearing if you change your window resolution.
[*]Fixed the arrow pointing to the yarn fading in and out at the wrong time.
[*]Fixed the "Load" reminder text fading out more slowly than the "Save" text when using a controller.
[*]Some small animation updates.
[/list]
